header: From your current spreadsheet to a published rota
lead: Most sites are live inside a fortnight. Nothing here needs an IT department, and none of it is billed as a project.

steps.title: Send us last year
steps.text: Export your rotas and staff list however they exist today. We take spreadsheets, PDFs and photographs of a wall planner.

steps.title: We set up the rules
steps.text: Contracts, opening hours, premium rates and who may work alone. This is the only part that needs a conversation.

steps.title: Invite the team
steps.text: Staff install the app and confirm their own contract details, which is usually where the first three errors turn up.

steps.title: Publish week one
steps.text: Run one week in parallel with the old plan. From week two, nobody goes back to the whiteboard.
